title: A Temporary Bus Stop
instructions: Listen carefully. Choose the option that best matches what is said or implied.

audio.description: A roadside announcement about a temporary stop change.

transcript.text: The next bus to the town centre will not stop outside the market today. Roadworks have closed that section of the street. Please wait opposite the public gardens; the bus will arrive at the usual time. Look for the temporary sign beside the crossing. Please wait behind the marked line.

questions.prompt: Why is the usual stop unavailable?
options: A market event is taking place.
Roadworks have closed that part of the street.
The bus is running an hour late.
The stop is being moved permanently.
questions.explanation: The announcement says roadworks have closed that section of the street.
The temporary stop is opposite the public gardens.

questions.prompt: What does the announcement imply about the timetable?
options: The bus time has not changed.
The bus will skip the town centre.
Passengers should expect a long delay.
questions.explanation: The speaker says the bus will arrive at the temporary stop at the usual time.
